/**
 * Minimal Cluster Script compatible Vector3 / Quaternion for the simulator.
 *
 * Follows https://docs.cluster.mu/script/ semantics:
 * - most methods mutate `this` and return it; clone() returns a copy
 * - angles are in degrees, Euler order is ZXY (Unity compatible)
 * - Quaternion.multiply(q) sets this = this * q
 * DOM independent so the same code runs in tests and in the browser preview.
 */
const DEG = Math.PI / 180;
class Vector3 {
    constructor(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.z = z;
    }
    set(x, y, z) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.z = z;
        return this;
    }
    clone() {
        return new Vector3(this.x, this.y, this.z);
    }
    add(v) {
        return this.set(this.x + v.x, this.y + v.y, this.z + v.z);
    }
    sub(v) {
        return this.set(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y, this.z - v.z);
    }
    multiplyScalar(s) {
        return this.set(this.x * s, this.y * s, this.z * s);
    }
    divideScalar(s) {
        return this.set(this.x / s, this.y / s, this.z / s);
    }
    negate() {
        return this.multiplyScalar(-1);
    }
    dot(v) {
        return this.x * v.x + this.y * v.y + this.z * v.z;
    }
    lengthSq() {
        return this.dot(this);
    }
    length() {
        return Math.sqrt(this.lengthSq());
    }
    normalize() {
        const len = this.length();
        return len > 0 ? this.divideScalar(len) : this;
    }
    lerp(v, a) {
        return this.set(this.x + (v.x - this.x) * a, this.y + (v.y - this.y) * a, this.z + (v.z - this.z) * a);
    }
    /** v' = q * v * q^-1 */
    applyQuaternion(q) {
        const { x, y, z } = this;
        const ix = q.w * x + q.y * z - q.z * y;
        const iy = q.w * y + q.z * x - q.x * z;
        const iz = q.w * z + q.x * y - q.y * x;
        const iw = -q.x * x - q.y * y - q.z * z;
        return this.set(ix * q.w + iw * -q.x + iy * -q.z - iz * -q.y, iy * q.w + iw * -q.y + iz * -q.x - ix * -q.z, iz * q.w + iw * -q.z + ix * -q.y - iy * -q.x);
    }
    equals(v, eps = 1e-6) {
        return Math.abs(this.x - v.x) < eps && Math.abs(this.y - v.y) < eps && Math.abs(this.z - v.z) < eps;
    }
}
class Quaternion {
    constructor(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, w = 1) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.z = z;
        this.w = w;
    }
    set(x, y, z, w) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.z = z;
        this.w = w;
        return this;
    }
    clone() {
        return new Quaternion(this.x, this.y, this.z, this.w);
    }
    identity() {
        return this.set(0, 0, 0, 1);
    }
    /** this = this * q */
    multiply(q) {
        const a = this;
        return this.set(a.w * q.x + a.x * q.w + a.y * q.z - a.z * q.y, a.w * q.y - a.x * q.z + a.y * q.w + a.z * q.x, a.w * q.z + a.x * q.y - a.y * q.x + a.z * q.w, a.w * q.w - a.x * q.x - a.y * q.y - a.z * q.z);
    }
    setFromAxisAngle(axis, degree) {
        const n = axis.clone().normalize();
        const half = (degree * DEG) / 2;
        const s = Math.sin(half);
        return this.set(n.x * s, n.y * s, n.z * s, Math.cos(half));
    }
    /** Degrees, applied Z then X then Y: q = qY * qX * qZ */
    setFromEulerAngles(xOrV, y, z) {
        const v = typeof xOrV === 'number' ? new Vector3(xOrV, y !== null && y !== void 0 ? y : 0, z !== null && z !== void 0 ? z : 0) : xOrV;
        const qx = new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(1, 0, 0), v.x);
        const qy = new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), v.y);
        const qz = new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 0, 1), v.z);
        const r = qy.multiply(qx).multiply(qz);
        return this.set(r.x, r.y, r.z, r.w);
    }
    /** Inverse of setFromEulerAngles (ZXY), degrees in [0, 360) like Unity. */
    createEulerAngles() {
        const { x, y, z, w } = this;
        const sinX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, 2 * (w * x - y * z)));
        const ex = Math.asin(sinX);
        let ey;
        let ez;
        if (Math.abs(sinX) < 0.9999999) {
            ey = Math.atan2(2 * (w * y + x * z), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y));
            ez = Math.atan2(2 * (w * z + x * y), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z));
        }
        else {
            ey = Math.atan2(-2 * (x * z - w * y), 1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z));
            ez = 0;
        }
        const wrap = (r) => ((r / DEG) % 360 + 360) % 360;
        return new Vector3(wrap(ex), wrap(ey), wrap(ez));
    }
    dot(q) {
        return this.x * q.x + this.y * q.y + this.z * q.z + this.w * q.w;
    }
    length() {
        return Math.sqrt(this.dot(this));
    }
    normalize() {
        const len = this.length() || 1;
        return this.set(this.x / len, this.y / len, this.z / len, this.w / len);
    }
    invert() {
        const d = this.dot(this) || 1;
        return this.set(-this.x / d, -this.y / d, -this.z / d, this.w / d);
    }
    slerp(q, a) {
        let cos = this.dot(q);
        let to = q.clone();
        if (cos < 0) {
            cos = -cos;
            to = new Quaternion(-q.x, -q.y, -q.z, -q.w);
        }
        if (cos > 0.9995) {
            return this.set(this.x + (to.x - this.x) * a, this.y + (to.y - this.y) * a, this.z + (to.z - this.z) * a, this.w + (to.w - this.w) * a).normalize();
        }
        const theta = Math.acos(cos);
        const sin = Math.sin(theta);
        const s0 = Math.sin((1 - a) * theta) / sin;
        const s1 = Math.sin(a * theta) / sin;
        return this.set(this.x * s0 + to.x * s1, this.y * s0 + to.y * s1, this.z * s0 + to.z * s1, this.w * s0 + to.w * s1);
    }
    /** Same rotation (q and -q are equivalent). */
    equals(q, eps = 1e-6) {
        return Math.abs(Math.abs(this.dot(q)) - 1) < eps;
    }
}

/**
 * Runs Jcreate++ generated Cluster Script on the `$` mock.
 *
 * Contract:
 * - Only code generated by Jcreate++ is executed (Function is not a sandbox).
 * - Every name the code may reference is passed explicitly; nothing is added to globals.
 * - Math.random is replaced per runner with a seeded generator; the global Math is untouched.
 * - An exception inside a callback is recorded and stops only that callback invocation.
 * - After the program changes, create a new runner instead of reusing state.

/** mulberry32 */
function seededRandom(seed) {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    return () => {
        a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
        let t = a;
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
}

            pending += seconds;

                runner.update(deltaTime);
            }
        },

        errors() {

/**
 * The one-line Japanese text of a simulator log entry. Pure; shared by the Web preview (panel.ts)
 * and the Unity preview (src/unityHost/host.ts), so both say the same thing.
 */
function formatLog(l) {
    switch (l.type) {
        case 'send': return `送信 → ${l.target}「${l.message}」${l.arg === null || l.arg === undefined ? '' : ` 値=${JSON.stringify(l.arg)}`}`;
        case 'audio': return `音「${l.id}」音量 ${l.volume}`;
        case 'text': return `文字 ${l.subNode}(${l.component}) = ${l.text}`;
        case 'enabled': return `${l.subNode}(${l.component}) を ${l.enabled ? '有効' : '無効'}`;
        case 'force': return `力を加える (${l.force.x.toFixed(1)}, ${l.force.y.toFixed(1)}, ${l.force.z.toFixed(1)}) ※物理は再現しません`;
        case 'player': return `プレイヤー ${l.method}(${l.value})`;
        case 'error': return `エラー[${l.event}] ${l.message}`;
    }
}

/**
 * The value typed next to 「受信」: empty = no value (null), true / false = boolean, a number = number,
 * anything else = text (so text that looks like a number cannot be sent). Shared by the Web preview
 * and the Unity preview.
 */
function parseReceiveValue(text) {
    const raw = text.trim();
    if (raw === '')
        return null;
    if (raw === 'true')
        return true;
    if (raw === 'false')
        return false;
    return isNaN(Number(raw)) ? raw : Number(raw);
}

/* harmony export */   variableStateKey: () => (/* binding */ variableStateKey)

/**
 * Jcreate++ 変数の正本（P7）
 *
 * - 変数の種類と $.state のキー名の規則（codegen もここを使う）
 * - IR から変数一覧（どこかで設定されているか / 読まれているか）を集める
 *
 * フラグは真偽値変数と同じもの（V-4）。クールダウンも「名前つきの値」として一覧に含める。
 */
const PREFIX = {
    number: 'var.',
    string: 'str.',
    bool: 'bool.',
    cooldown: '__jpp_cd_',
};
const DEFAULT_VALUE = {
    number: 0,
    string: '',
    bool: false,
    cooldown: 0,
};
const VARIABLE_KIND_LABEL = {
    number: '数値変数',
    string: '文字変数',
    bool: '真偽値変数・フラグ',
    cooldown: 'クールダウン',
};
function variableStateKey(kind, name) {
    return PREFIX[kind] + name;
}
function variableDefaultValue(kind) {
    return DEFAULT_VALUE[kind];
}
/** How each IR node kind touches variables. */
const ACCESS = {
    number_var: { kind: 'number', read: true },
    string_var: { kind: 'string', read: true },
    bool_var: { kind: 'bool', read: true },
    flag: { kind: 'bool', read: true },
    cooldown_remaining: { kind: 'cooldown', read: true },
    cooldown_active: { kind: 'cooldown', read: true },
    set_number_var: { kind: 'number', write: true },
    change_number_var: { kind: 'number', read: true, write: true },
    set_string_var: { kind: 'string', write: true },
    set_bool_var: { kind: 'bool', write: true },
    set_flag: { kind: 'bool', write: true },
    start_cooldown: { kind: 'cooldown', write: true },
};
/**
 * All variables used by the program, sorted by kind then name.
 * Walks every nested node, so new statement / expression kinds are covered automatically.
 */
function collectVariables(program) {
    const found = new Map();
    const visit = (node) => {
        var _a;
        if (Array.isArray(node)) {
            node.forEach(visit);
            return;
        }
        if (!node || typeof node !== 'object')
            return;
        const record = node;
        const access = typeof record.kind === 'string' ? ACCESS[record.kind] : undefined;
        if (access && typeof record.name === 'string') {
            const toggles = record.kind === 'set_flag' && record.operation === 'toggle';
            const key = variableStateKey(access.kind, record.name);
            const info = (_a = found.get(key)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : {
                kind: access.kind,
                name: record.name,
                stateKey: key,
                defaultValue: variableDefaultValue(access.kind),
                written: false,
                read: false,
            };
            info.written || (info.written = !!access.write);
            info.read || (info.read = !!access.read || toggles);
            found.set(key, info);
        }
        for (const [field, child] of Object.entries(record)) {
            if (field !== 'src' && field !== 'variables')
                visit(child);
        }
    };
    visit(program);
    const order = ['number', 'string', 'bool', 'cooldown'];
    return [...found.values()].sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a.kind) - order.indexOf(b.kind) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

/**
 * Entry point of the Unity editor preview (unity/Jcreatepp/Editor/Preview). Bundled on its own by
 * webpack.unity.config.js into one script exposing the global `JcreateppHost`, which Unity runs in
 * Jint (a C# JavaScript engine). It runs a generated Cluster Script on the same simulator as the
 * Web preview (src/sim), so both previews move the same way.
 *
 * Contract for the C# side (SimHost.cs):
 * - Arguments and results are numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain objects only.
 * - Functions do not use `this`; they can be called without a receiver.
 * - Log entries are collected right after each load / step / fire and stamped with the simulation
 *   time of that moment; snapshot() returns the entries added since the previous snapshot().
 * - Unity has only the .js (no block / IR information), so the state shows what is in $.state at
 *   run time: a variable appears once it has a value. Nothing is guessed (no "never set" notes).
 */





const LOG_KEPT = 200;
let runner = null;
let pending = [];
let lastError = '';
/** Moves the runner's new log entries into `pending`, stamped with the current simulation time. */
function collect() {
    if (!runner)
        return;
    // splice, not reassignment: the mock keeps a reference to this array.
    const entries = runner.log.splice(0);
    for (const entry of entries) {
        const text = (0,_preview_logText__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__.formatLog)(entry);
        pending.push({ time: runner.time, kind: entry.type, text });
        if (entry.type === 'error')
            lastError = text;
    }
    if (pending.length > LOG_KEPT)
        pending.splice(0, pending.length - LOG_KEPT);
}
/**
 * Creates a runner for `code` at the given start transform and runs its 開始時 (onStart).
 * ok = false when the code itself cannot run (syntax error, error at the top level); an error inside
 * onStart is logged and reported as lastError, with ok = true.
 */
function load(code, px, py, pz, qx, qy, qz, qw) {
    runner = null;
    pending = [];
    lastError = '';
    try {
        runner = (0,_sim_runner__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__.createRunner)(code, { position: new _sim_math__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.Vector3(px, py, pz), rotation: new _sim_math__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.Quaternion(qx, qy, qz, qw) });
    }
    catch (e) {
        const error = `スクリプトを実行できません: ${e.name}: ${e.message}`;
        lastError = error;
        return { ok: false, error };
    }
    runner.start();
    collect();
    return { ok: true, error: '' };
}
/** Advances the simulation by one frame of `dt` seconds. */
function step(dt) {
    if (!runner)
        return;
    runner.update(dt);
    collect();
}
/** Raises an event: interact, grab, release, collide, receive (with a message name and the typed value). */
function fire(name, message, value) {
    if (!runner)
        return;
    switch (name) {
        case 'interact':
            runner.interact();
            break;
        case 'grab':
            runner.grab(true);
            break;
        case 'release':
            runner.grab(false);
            break;
        case 'collide':
            runner.collide();
            break;
        case 'receive':
            runner.receive(message, (0,_preview_receiveValue__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_3__.parseReceiveValue)(value));
            break;
    }
    collect();
}
const KINDS = ['number', 'string', 'bool', 'cooldown'];
function stateRows(state) {
    const rows = [];
    const keys = Object.keys(state).sort();
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
        const prefix = (0,_variables__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_4__.variableStateKey)(kind, '');
        for (const key of keys) {
            if (!key.startsWith(prefix))
                continue;
            const value = state[key];
            let text;
            switch (kind) {
                case 'bool':
                    text = value ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
                    break;
                case 'cooldown': {
                    const left = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);
                    text = left > 0 ? `あと ${left.toFixed(2)} 秒` : '待機なし';
                    break;
                }
                case 'string':
                    text = JSON.stringify(String(value));
                    break;
                default: text = String(value);
            }
            rows.push({ kind, group: _variables__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_4__.VARIABLE_KIND_LABEL[kind], name: key.slice(prefix.length), text });
        }
    }
    // Sequences, numbered in the order their keys appear (no block names in a .js).
    const seqKeys = keys.filter((k) => k.startsWith('__jpp_seq_active_'));
    seqKeys.forEach((key, i) => {
        var _a;
        const id = key.slice('__jpp_seq_active_'.length);
        const step = Number((_a = state[`__jpp_seq_step_${id}`]) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0) + 1;
        rows.push({ kind: 'sequence', group: '一連の動作', name: `一連の動作 ${i + 1}`, text: state[key] ? `実行中（ステップ ${step}）` : '停止' });
    });
    return rows;
}
function snapshot() {
    if (!runner)
        return null;
    const p = runner.item.position;
    const q = runner.item.rotation;
    const e = q.createEulerAngles();
    const h = runner.handlers;
    const events = [];
    if (h.interact)
        events.push('interact');
    // One onGrab callback handles both grabbing and releasing.
    if (h.grab)
        events.push('grab', 'release');
    if (h.collide)
        events.push('collide');
    if (h.receive)
        events.push('receive');
    const log = pending;
    pending = [];
    return {
        time: runner.time,
        position: [p.x, p.y, p.z],
        rotation: [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w],
        euler: [e.x, e.y, e.z],
        events,
        state: stateRows(runner.$.state),
        log,
        lastError,
        unsupported: [...runner.unsupported],
    };
}

})();
